svg.title: Cold War in Asia: Proxy Wars in Korea & Vietnam (1949–1975)
svg.desc: KS3 historical GIS atlas map of East and Southeast Asia (1949–1975) using 1960 historical boundaries showing the USSR, Communist China (1949, including Hainan Island) and Domino Theory, Divided Korea at the 38th Parallel with the UN Inchon landing (1950–53), Divided Vietnam at the 17th Parallel DMZ (1954), the Gulf of Tonkin and Ho Chi Minh Trail through Laos and Cambodia, and the Fall of Saigon (April 1975).

svg.text: KS3 HISTORY • YEAR 9 ENQUIRY: THE COLD WAR (1945–1991)
Cold War in Asia: Proxy Wars in Korea & Vietnam (1949–1975)
Afraid of direct nuclear war in Europe, the superpowers fought bloody Asian proxy wars in Korea (1950–53) and Vietnam (1954–75).
US containment held the 38th Parallel in Korea, but Vietcong guerrilla warfare defeated American firepower in Vietnam by 1975.
